data.name: Ricky Raccoon 2 - Adventures in Egypt
data.detailed_description:
Ricky Raccoon 2: Adventures in Egypt features everybody's favourite raccoon at the Nile. After his successful treasure hunt at the Amazon river, his 2nd big expedition into the unknown awaits our little adventurers. He will join his grandpa and a parrot on their quest for 5 mysterious artefacts hidden in the past of ancient Egypt. Will they manage to solve the riddles from a time long gone and restore an Egyptian city to its old glory?

Just like in the 1st part our adventurers will have to master challenging Match 3 missions to make it all the way to the hidden treasures. On his quest Ricky will visit 6 different locations, all of which are presented in Full HD graphics. While digging deeper and deeper into the mythical world of ancient Egypt, our little raccoon has to solve 100 lovingly crafted and colourful levels, which will put his skills to the ultimate test. In addition to the Relax mode you can look forward to a total of 6 game modes. Will Ricky Raccoon ever manage to become as great a treasure hunter as his grandpa?

Features

  • The sequel to the adventure game hit!
  • An exciting treasure hunt with little Ricky Raccoon
  • Exciting story set in ancient Egypt
  • Detailed Full HD graphics
  • 100 Levels
  • Relax mode
  • 6 game modes
  • Exotic Match 3 treasure hunt

reviews.review:
Ricky Raccoon 2: Adventures in Egypt is a casual puzzle adventure developed by Makivision Games and published by familyplay that combines match-based gameplay with treasure hunting and light exploration themes. Taking its energetic raccoon protagonist into the deserts and ruins of ancient Egypt, the game builds an experience centered around puzzle-solving, discovery, and family-friendly adventure. Rather than focusing on complexity or demanding mechanics, it aims to deliver an approachable journey filled with colorful presentation and gradual progression that appeals to players looking for a more relaxed style of gameplay.

The adventure begins with Ricky setting out alongside his grandfather and trusted parrot companion on a new expedition in search of ancient artifacts hidden throughout Egypt. Their objective revolves around uncovering long-lost treasures scattered across mysterious locations inspired by Egyptian history and mythology. The story itself remains simple and lighthearted, serving primarily as motivation for progression rather than driving the experience with heavy narrative elements. The setup succeeds because it provides a clear purpose while keeping the tone welcoming and easy to follow.

Gameplay follows a familiar puzzle structure built around matching pieces to complete objectives and advance through stages. Players who enjoy traditional match-based puzzle games will immediately recognize the mechanics. The learning curve stays approachable, allowing newcomers to understand systems quickly while introducing gradually increasing difficulty as progression continues. Early stages encourage experimentation and comfort with the mechanics, while later challenges demand stronger planning and more efficient decision-making.

One of the game's stronger qualities comes from how effectively it uses its setting to strengthen progression. Ancient Egypt provides more than visual decoration. Exploring temples, ruins, and treasure-filled locations creates a stronger sense of adventure than many puzzle games built around simpler themes. Each new location contributes visual variety while reinforcing the feeling of participating in a larger expedition rather than moving through disconnected puzzle boards.

The progression system benefits from a large amount of puzzle content spread across multiple environments. As players move deeper into Ricky’s journey, objectives become increasingly varied without overwhelming the overall structure. New puzzle situations help maintain engagement while preventing gameplay from becoming entirely repetitive. Difficulty rises steadily enough to encourage improvement while remaining accessible to players who prefer a more casual experience.

An additional strength comes through flexibility in how players approach progression. Different play options allow players to experience puzzles according to their preferred pace. Those looking for a more relaxed experience can focus on solving puzzles without unnecessary pressure, while others can approach challenges with greater emphasis on efficiency and optimization. This balance makes the experience more welcoming across different skill levels.

Presentation contributes heavily to the game’s identity. Bright environments, colorful artwork, and cheerful visual design create an atmosphere that aligns naturally with the family-friendly tone. Ancient Egyptian influences appear throughout environments and help reinforce the treasure-hunting theme without sacrificing accessibility. The art direction favors charm over realism, which fits particularly well within the game's casual design philosophy.

Visual readability remains another positive aspect. Puzzle mechanics rely heavily on quickly recognizing board layouts and available opportunities, and Ricky Raccoon 2 keeps information easy to process during gameplay. The clean presentation supports progression effectively while helping maintain a comfortable gameplay rhythm across longer sessions.

The game’s simplicity may not appeal equally to every player. Puzzle veterans searching for highly advanced systems or dramatic innovation may encounter familiar mechanics driving much of the experience. Ricky Raccoon 2 remains focused on accessibility and comfort rather than complexity. However, players who enjoy casual puzzle adventures built around steady progression and charming presentation will likely find those familiar ideas part of the experience’s appeal.

What helps Ricky Raccoon 2 remain enjoyable is how confidently it commits to its intended audience. It does not attempt to become a deep strategy game or an elaborate narrative adventure. Instead, it focuses entirely on delivering approachable puzzle gameplay supported by a memorable setting and a satisfying sense of progression.

Ricky Raccoon 2: Adventures in Egypt succeeds by combining traditional puzzle mechanics with a playful treasure-hunting adventure that remains consistently welcoming from beginning to end. The Egyptian setting adds personality, the progression remains rewarding, and the casual structure makes it easy to enjoy across both short and extended play sessions. Players looking for a lighter puzzle experience with colorful presentation and adventure themes will likely find an enjoyable expedition waiting beneath the sands.

Rating: 7/10
